Dependencies are stored locally so the editor works without a CDN or build step.

- Acorn 8.15.0: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn (MIT; see acorn/LICENSE). Parses JavaScript for inline syntax diagnostics.

- CodeMirror 5.65.20: https://codemirror.net/5/ (MIT; see codemirror/LICENSE).
- @emmetio/codemirror-plugin 1.2.4: https://github.com/emmetio/codemirror-plugin (MIT; see emmet/LICENSE).

Files downloaded from version-pinned npm packages through https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/.
